Apakah Anda ingin saya membantu mencari informasi lebih lanjut (misalnya menghubungi toko atau mengecek situs resmi)?

The user writes in Indonesian: "Gan celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L ready g gan..?" They ask: "Gan celana dalam 1 lusin ukuran L ready g gan..?" Means: "Bro, are there 12 pairs of underwear size L ready?".

We need to respond appropriately. We have no context about inventory. We might say we don't have that info. But maybe we can ask clarifying question or provide generic answer. According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should ask for clarification or say we cannot confirm. Probably ask: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki akses ke inventaris saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin saya memeriksa stok?" Or something.

We can also ask for location or store. But we can respond politely: "Saya tidak dapat memastikan apakah ada stok. Silakan hubungi toko atau cek situs." That would be safe.

Thus answer: "Maaf, saya tidak memiliki data tentang stok saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin saya membantu mencari informasi lebih lanjut?"
